why_a_spec_and_not_a_sentence: The base contract states the obligation as prose: 'protected assay state not in ancestors_of(birth/death/resource-transition)'. That sentence does not fix the node set, the edge direction, the sink set, the failure taxonomy, or what happens when a declaration is incomplete. Two honest implementers would build two different checks from it, and one of them would return PASS on a leaking world. This file fixes all five.

inputs.kernels: Mapping[str, {'reads': Sequence[str], 'writes': Sequence[str]}] — from WORLD_STATE_AND_DYNAMICS_V1 as amended by AMEND_1
inputs.protected: Set[str] — from ASSAY_TRANSFER_CONTRACT_V1 protected state names
inputs.sinks: Set[str] — birth/death decision variables plus resource-transition variables

graph_construction.nodes: every state name in any kernel's reads or writes, plus one node per kernel
edges: for each kernel k and each r in reads(k):  r -> k
for each kernel k and each w in writes(k): k -> w
graph_construction.ancestors_of: reflexive-transitive closure along REVERSED edges, seeded from the sink set
graph_construction.name_matching: exact string match, plus dotted-prefix containment so that 'x.a' is matched by a declared read of 'x' — a kernel that declares it reads the whole organism record reads the assay field too
graph_construction.prefix_rule_rationale: Coarse declarations must be treated as MORE permissive, never less. Declaring reads=['x'] must not launder a read of x.a.

prefix_rule_is_bidirectional.rule: A declared name covers a target when either is a dotted prefix of the other.
prefix_rule_is_bidirectional.why_both_directions: Both directions widen, never narrow. A kernel declaring reads=['x'] must be treated as reading x.a, so a coarse declaration cannot launder a fine-grained read. A sink declared as 'E.resources' is likewise matched by the coarser declared name 'E', so the sink set grows.
prefix_rule_is_bidirectional.direction_of_error: Widening either the sink set or the protected set errs toward VIOLATION and never toward PASS. A conservative check that over-alarms is recoverable by amendment; one that under-alarms silently licenses a false spontaneous-cognition claim.
prefix_rule_is_bidirectional.evidence_the_check_still_discriminates: The closure covers 16 of 42 nodes, not all of them. It contains the organism's cognitive state (x.F, x.O, x.Pi, x.h, x.q, x.s) -- correctly, since behaviour affects resources which affect reproduction -- and excludes every protected assay name. That separation is the PASS.

outputs.witness_path: required and non-empty on VIOLATION: the node sequence from the protected name to the sink
outputs.reason: required and non-empty on CANNOT_CHECK: which kernel or which name could not be resolved
outputs.checked_kernels: count of kernels whose reads and writes both resolved

exit_codes.0: PASS — the ancestor closure of the sinks is disjoint from the protected names
exit_codes.2: VIOLATION — at least one directed path exists; the witness path is emitted
exit_codes.3: CANNOT_CHECK — a kernel omitted reads or writes, or a declared name is not in the state vocabulary

cannot_check_is_never_pass.rule: Exit 3 must never be folded into exit 0, and no caller may treat a CANNOT_CHECK verdict as satisfying section 17 condition 2.

selftest_obligation.rule: The checker must assert BOTH directions on real declarations before any verdict it produces is trusted.

required_cases.input: the clean declared factorization from AMEND_1
required_cases.why: a gate only ever seen not firing has not been validated

required_cases.input: K_senseact reads x.a and writes x.r, which K_birthdeath reads
required_cases.why: this is the H-LEAK-ASSAY-ENERGY hostile: assay value moves energy, energy moves reproduction one step later

required_cases.input: K_birthdeath reads the whole record x
required_cases.why: a coarse declaration must not launder a fine-grained read
the H-LEAK-HIDDEN-EDGE hostile is exactly an incomplete graph; it must not present as PASS

selftest_obligation.pattern_source: research/ocm-form-oracle-v1/oracle/c_immutability.py selftest(), which asserts both the no-alarm and the alarm direction

consequence_of_violation.effect: Invalidates any spontaneous or general cognition claim for that run.
consequence_of_violation.does_not_invalidate: an ASSAY_SELECTED_CONTROL arm, which is declared to leak by construction and is scored separately

scope_limits.what_this_proves: The DECLARED graph has no path from protected names to selection.
what_this_does_not_prove: that the declaration matches the running simulator
that no unregistered side channel exists in the implementation
scope_limits.residual_obligation_on_EB_F0_X: Bind the declaration to the executing kernels so that the graph is derived from the code rather than asserted alongside it. Until then the strongest available claim is DECLARED_GRAPH_NONINTERFERENCE, not RUN_NONINTERFERENCE.
scope_limits.matching_theorem_row: BIO-T1, whose assumptions already include 'graph complete for protected outputs' and 'no hidden side channel'
